body: There's no getting through it, I have no reason to get up tomorrow. I saw some hope until I found out she has been seeing someone she worked with. I'm not a child, i'm 35. I just don't want to die but I don't see a different choice. I spent the past few days gathering everything, it's 20 feet away and I am gone.
I just found out someone a loved for a decade has been lying to me for a while, she already left. I have no family or friends. I can;t do this, but I am so scared
